text:
Maya (CSM): FYI flagged by health-checker: BrightLeaf dropped active seats 42% last 30d, renewal in 28 days. tagging @Jorge to own save plan?
Jorge (AM): on it. quick context? last usage spike was Jan then steady drop after rollout. any NPS/feedback?
Maya (CSM): NPS last quarter 6.5, said docs were fine but model latency and cost were common complaints. They downgraded compute tier last month.
Priya (Enablement): could do a targeted 30-min workshop for their eng + product next Tue. low lift: demo of batching + kv-cache tips.
Tom (Support): I can pull recent error rates and latency per route. suspect their canary config reverted to small batch size.
Maya (CSM): ok plan draft: 1) triage (support data + usage query) 2) targeted activation (workshop + checklist) 3) incentive (3-month discount or free uplift credits) 4) downgrade-deflection flow (clear path to keep them on current plan) 5) monitor + escalate.
Jorge (AM): prefer credits over discount. offer: $2k platform credits + a dedicated tuning session. if they still request downgrade, propose a staged downgrade with SLA guardrails.
Priya (Enablement): workshop agenda (15m perf knobs, 10m prompts + cost-control, 5m Q&A). will prepare a short follow-up playbook doc and a one-pager checklist: "activation-runbook.pdf" link to be added.
Tom (Support): quick query I ran: ```SELECT org_id, count(*) as calls_7d, avg(latency_ms) FROM request_logs WHERE org_id='brightleaf' AND timestamp > NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY org_id;``` shows avg latency jumped from 220ms -> 480ms post-2026-02-12 deploy.
Maya (CSM): that's the spike. action items: @Tom attach error logs + any rollbacks; @Priya schedule workshop and draft checklist; @Jorge prepare credit offer and approved fallback pricing; I'll book renewal sync and send the initial outreach email.
Jorge (AM): will draft outreach now, short + options: 1) enablement + credits 2) fast downgrade with auto-restore window 3) pilot of quantized model for cost savings.
Maya (CSM): outreach copy mock: "Hey BrightLeaf — we saw usage dip and want to help. can we run a 30-min session to tune performance and discuss credits to offset any friction?" keep it soft.
Priya (Enablement): I'll prep a 3-bullet checklist for post-workshop follow-up: (a) config changes made, (b) performance delta measured, (c) buy-in for keeping current plan.
Tom (Support): adding a quick runbook snippet for downgrade-deflection steps: ```- freeze auto-downgrade for 14 days; - enable kv-cache default prefix=true; - suggest batch_size=16 for short seqs; - enable prefix caching for chat endpoints```
Maya (CSM): love it. timeline: workshop within 5 business days, credits approved by EOD tomorrow, monitor 14 days post-intervention.
cs-bot: Reminder: create a "save-plan" jira ticket for BRIGHTLEAF-1021 assigned to @Jorge.
Jorge (AM): taking BRIGHTLEAF-1021, will update with offer + meeting scheduling.
Maya (CSM): thanks team. quick note: capture all customer feedback in Canny under "onboarding/perf" so product sees the signal. :eyes:
Priya (Enablement): will also record the session and share a 6-min highlight clip.
Tom (Support): posting the logs and perf graph in the ticket. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): closing loop — if no uplift in 14 days, escalate to CS-lead for tailored contract play.
Jorge (AM): noted. keeping this thread as the single source for the save-plan.
Maya (CSM): cool, I'll send the outreach now. :white_check_mark:
